result.title: Your website brief
result.attachDesc: You indicated you have existing copy or images ready. Paste them directly after this prompt when submitting to your AI coding tool — the brief already instructs it to use your content as the primary source.
result.freeNotice: All listed tools are free — most offer a free tier or a free trial on first sign-up. You can try the same prompt in all of them. Every method was verified working when this site was built. If one isn't available, simply switch to another tab.
result.boltStep3: Paste your generated prompt into the chat input.
result.boltStep4: Press Enter — Bolt will start building immediately.
result.lovableStep3: Paste your prompt as the project description.
result.lovableStep4: Click "Generate" — Lovable will scaffold your website.
result.arenaStep4: Select Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the model.
result.arenaStep5: Paste your prompt and press Enter.
result.arenaTip: For best results, choose Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the model — it gives the most detailed and accurate output.
result.cursorStep1: Open Cursor and create or open a project folder.
result.cursorStep2: Press Cmd+I (Mac) or Ctrl+I (Windows) to open the AI panel.
result.cursorStep4: Paste your prompt and press Enter — Cursor will scaffold the project.
result.v0Step2: Paste your generated prompt into the input at the top.
result.v0Step3: Press Enter — v0 will generate React components.
result.v0Step4: Copy or export the code into your project.

step.attachDesc: When you paste the generated prompt into your AI tool, add your existing copy and images directly after it. The brief will instruct the AI to use your content as the primary source.

q1.label: Tell us about your business
q1.hint: Your contact details will appear directly in your website — the AI uses them to populate the contact section with real information instead of placeholders.

q2.label: What type of website do you need?

q3.label: What is your industry and niche?
q3.placeholder: e.g. sustainable fashion brand, B2B SaaS for accountants, local Italian restaurant...

q4.label: What is the primary goal of your website?

q5.label: Who is your target audience?
q5.placeholder: e.g. female entrepreneurs aged 28–45, small business owners who are not tech-savvy, Gen Z gamers...

q6.label: What visual style fits your brand?

q7.label: What tone of voice should the website use?

q8.label: Do you have brand colors?
q8.placeholder: e.g. #1A1A2E and warm gold — or 'deep navy, cream, and terracotta'

q10.label: What is the status of your content?
q10.opt0: I have all text and images ready
q10.opt1: I have text but need image guidance
q10.opt2: I need placeholder text and image suggestions
q10.opt3: I need the AI to write all copy too

q11.label: Any special features or functionality?
q11.placeholder: e.g. booking calendar, user login, live chat, product filters, payment checkout, map, multi-language...

q12.label: Where will you build or host your website?
q12.hint: Not sure? Pick the first option — the AI will choose the best fit. If you're using an AI coding tool (Bolt, v0, Lovable, Cursor), choose React/Next.js or Plain HTML.
q12.opt0: Not sure — AI picks the best fit
q12.opt1: React / Next.js — for Bolt, v0, Lovable, Cursor
q12.opt2: Plain HTML + CSS — simple, works everywhere

q13.label: Any references, inspiration, or extra context?
q13.placeholder: e.g. I love stripe.com for its clarity. Budget ~$3k, need it live in 6 weeks.
